statements.because: The authenticated request user is the principal whose access is tested.
The document identified by the path primary key is the object passed to the owner-aware permission check.
This is the document whose source or archive file is ultimately served.
When a user exists and the owner-aware view_document check fails, the function returns a forbidden response.
A failed owner-aware check returns HTTP 403 before file-document selection.
When the path identifies a version and no version parameter is supplied, that request document itself becomes the effective file document.
After permission is evaluated on request_doc, serve_file receives the selected file_doc and chooses source versus archive representation.
The exact original=true test and archive-availability branch choose a representation but do not perform another authorization check.
